RWA.note: The release says the central banks launched a proof of concept; it states no licensing or switch oversight role.

facts.fact: The National Bank of Rwanda and the National Bank of Cambodia jointly launched a proof of concept on 15 November 2026 linking Cambodia's Bakong to Rwanda's eKash, run by R-Switch, so customers in Cambodia can send money to Rwandan bank accounts and wallets.
facts.system: Cambodia-Rwanda Bakong-eKash cross-border remittance proof of concept

RWA.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The joint central-bank release describes eKash, operated by R-Switch, as Rwanda's national payment system, through which funds reach beneficiaries' bank accounts and digital wallets.
